Drop element writes nothing for an inline data image

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<p>Before <img src="data:image/png;base64,AAAA" alt="icon"> after</p>"#;
    let options_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"inline_data_media":"DropElement"}"#).unwrap();
    let options: ConversionOptions = serde_json::from_value(options_json).unwrap();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone())).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
